title: The Week Markets Met Machine-Led Business
subtitle: Ten shifts connecting global technology with Indian business decisions.
seoDescription: A plain-English weekly digest of consequential global market and technology events, their concrete impact on India, and practical opportunities for builders.
author: XDCoderz
closingSynthesis: Across the week, infrastructure and policy moved closer to machine-led commerce. Indian builders have room to turn that transition into practical, accountable products.
